Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, as reports link him to former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang. The controversy has taken a geopolitical turn, with allegations of Chinese espionage, questions over Nvidia's AI chip exports and scrutiny of Megaspeed's business links with Chinese companies.
